purpose: 主菜单前景：植物远征车、可点击地图与木牌。中文标题和按钮文字由Godot绘制。

prompt: Create ONE new production-quality transparent foreground game-art sprite for a Plants vs. Zombies adventure main menu. The supplied screenshot is a STYLE AND CAMERA reference ONLY, do not reproduce its village, UI, text or background. Output only the new foreground ensemble on true alpha transparency. Landscape canvas about 3:2. Hand-painted 2D cartoon game art, confident dark ink outlines, textured warm wood, rich healthy leaf greens, creamy parchment, no photorealism, no 3D plastic. Match the reference's elevated three-quarter view and soft daylight from upper left. ART DIRECTION: 'the plant expedition is ready to leave'. A lovable original Peashooter on the LEFT (iconic large round green head, tubular pea snout pointing slightly toward the viewer/right, lively dark eyes, leaf feet, tiny worn leather explorer satchel) and a joyful original Sunflower on the RIGHT (round friendly face, golden petals, green stem/leaf feet) flank a beautiful well-used wooden expedition handcart / map table. They look like characters waiting for the player to join an adventure, warm and expressive. The centre table has a large unfurled creamy illustrated treasure map with a few small green island silhouettes and a delicate red dashed route, rolled map edges, a small brass compass. Add a tidy backpack strapped low on one side, a couple of simple clay plant pots low down, and a small unlit brass lantern on the lower right. Keep the composition clear and iconic, not a heap of random props. The cart has two sturdy old wood wheels and believable leaf/wood contact shadows. Entire ensemble fully within image with 5% transparent padding, absolutely no cropping. VERY IMPORTANT INTERACTIVE RESERVE: the front face of the cart is a wide simple horizontal warm honey-brown wooden plank, centred in the lower middle, broad enough to hold four Chinese characters later, unobstructed by plants or supplies. Leave this front plank completely blank. No lettering anywhere, no logo, no symbols that resemble text, no user interface, no rectangular backdrop, no ground tile or landscape, no border. Contact shadows may be soft translucent alpha only. Make the two characters, the open map, and blank wooden front plank immediately readable at reduced scale. New image is an asset, not a full screenshot.
